name: Lenneth
source:
The Kingdom's Queen as well as the founder and Principal of the Adventurers' Academy.
Bearer of immense strength, she is stoic, serious, and dignified.
Brilliant as both a fighter and ruler, she's a hero who saved the world back when she was an adventurer.
Treasures her daughter Alice, given to her by God, more than anything.
